idh.reasoning: The MRI metadata favors IDH-wildtype disease: advanced age, marked contrast enhancement, substantial enhancing tumor volume, necrotic component, extensive edema, and deep white matter invasion are more typical of an aggressive IDH-wildtype glioblastoma phenotype. Features that could point away from IDH-wildtype include cortical involvement, an insular/parietal component, and a solitary lesion, which can be seen in IDH-mutant diffuse gliomas. Overall, the high-grade enhancing-necrotic pattern in an older adult outweighs the cortical/insular hemispheric features, so the best estimate is IDH-wildtype.

Despite those mitigating features, the enhancing-necrotic pattern and edema burden support grade 4 as the best estimate.
